description: Get dated challenge links for Parcel Relay, Spoonbound, Snack Sway or UNBOLT. Omit game to get all four. Dates use UTC and default to today; future dates are unavailable. UNBOLT rotates existing puzzles. Returns links and instructions without puzzle solutions, future snack sequences or saved progress.

date.description: A real calendar date from 2000 through 2099, no later than today in UTC. Defaults to today.

game.description: Omit to return every supported daily challenge.

language.description: Language of the returned content and links.

name: get_daily_challenge
title: Get daily game challenges
